newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 24.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 24.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- The forint's crawling peg devaluation will be reduced to 1.0 percent on August 15 from the current monthly 1.1 percent.
- Junior coalition partner Free Democrats have proposed that a referendum on Hungary's NATO membership be held early next year.
- Budapest council will close another six downtown restaurant for illegal practices.
- Opposition Christian Demnocrat party President was upheld in his position by a Supreme Court decision.
- Gabor Horvath replaces Gabor Szentivanyi as Foreign Ministry spokesman.
